description: PLAN phase 6, designed now and grown with each feature: a player installer with zero-touch install and byte-exact uninstall checked against the snapshot (D25); the exe guard's pass-through proven as the Steam-update safety net (altered identity runs vanilla); saves load with and without the mod; a support bundle (logs, config, dumps, no personal data); LICENSES.txt (DXVK zlib, RmlUi MIT, fonts OFL, ...); release values for every config key (including proxy.minidump, J1 open question 1); versioned releases with generated notes.
title: Release packaging, install and support
